first.rationale: Promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMBs and has prior acquisition and revenue evidence. Verify its downstream revenue quality and durability, while using onboarding evidence as the strongest alternative given the current completion decline. Until those records are reviewed, limit the plan to a guarded segment-targeted test.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. The verified source directly matches the current completion decline and showed higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, aligning with sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitor pressure because its verified cohort suffered a 12% retention decline and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Monitor activation, qualified revenue, and retention alongside completion.
